claim: Drives the eyebrows on their own, separate from the overall emotion word. Brows carry more of an anime face's read than the mouth does, so a director overrides them to get scepticism onto an otherwise neutral face without restating the performance.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: raised eyebrow, one eyebrow up, asymmetric brows
sad eyebrows, raised inner eyebrows, worried brow
angry eyebrows, v-shaped brows, sharply angled eyebrows

look_at: furrowed/angry_v/pleading read; raised hides in profile; flat is a control duplicate.
